_note: PS Merchant rework 2026-08-09, read off the live item API on 2026-08-10: 'Autocast Mammonite does not consume zeny and is unaffected by Zeny Pincher.' Zeny Pincher is a DAMAGE term on PS (it halves Mammonite's per-level ratio term, 100+50×lv → 100+25×lv), so exempting the autocast restores its full ratio — 600% instead of 350% at Lv10. Only Pirate Skel Card's autocast is exempt; a manual Mammonite still takes the Zeny Pincher cut.
